title: Precipitation of vanadium from leachate solutions by reduction with hydrazine
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,19895-19902
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02758J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Aston C. Pearcy, Brooke L. Matthews, Aaron T. Marshall, Chris W. Bumby
A novel zero-liquid-discharge hydrazine precipitation route has been developed that can precipitate highly pure vanadium oxide products with high efficiency. This process generates solid vanadium products, clean water and volatile by-products.
